headline: 3 arrested as BNP leader killed over World Cup dispute in Adabor
summary: The murder of Abul Bashar Badshah followed a series of clashes sparked by a dispute over celebrating a Brazil-Japan football match.
details: Police have arrested three suspects—Shoaib, Arman, and Nayan—in connection with the murder of Abul Bashar Badshah, the general secretary of the local BNP unit in Adabor, Dhaka.
The conflict reportedly began on Tuesday night following Brazil's World Cup victory over Japan, when a dispute broke out between local residents during celebrations.
The tension escalated over the following days, leading to multiple assaults and attempts by local BNP leaders to resolve the matter through arbitration.
During a meeting at an office in Nobodoy Bazar on Wednesday, clashes erupted between two factions, during which Badshah and another man named Saddam were hacked and severely injured.
Badshah was later declared dead at Dhaka Medical College Hospital around 11:30 PM.
Police confirmed that several individuals involved in the dispute, including the attackers and the victim, were linked to local BNP politics.
caption:
A World Cup celebration turned deadly. 3 arrested after a BNP leader was killed in Dhaka.

Police have arrested three suspects—Shoaib, Arman, and Nayan—in connection with the murder of Abul Bashar Badshah, the general secretary of the local BNP unit in Adabor, Dhaka.

The conflict reportedly began on Tuesday night following Brazil's World Cup victory over Japan, when a dispute broke out between local residents during celebrations.

The tension escalated over the following days, leading to multiple assaults and attempts by local BNP leaders to resolve the matter through arbitration.

During a meeting at an office in Nobodoy Bazar on Wednesday, clashes erupted between two factions, during which Badshah and another man named Saddam were hacked and severely injured.

Badshah was later declared dead at Dhaka Medical College Hospital around 11:30 PM.

Police confirmed that several individuals involved in the dispute, including the attackers and the victim, were linked to local BNP politics.

headline_marked: 2,500 workers [[jobless as five factories shut]] in Gazipur
headline: 2,500 workers jobless as five factories shut in Gazipur
summary: Thousands of garment workers face sudden unemployment after the closure of five industrial units in the Gazipur district.
details: Five factories in Gazipur have shut down, leaving approximately 2,500 workers without a source of income.
The sudden closures have left thousands of families struggling to make ends meet as they face immediate unemployment.
The affected workers are now seeking solutions and support to address their loss of livelihoods.
Local authorities and industry representatives are being urged to ensure that workers receive their due wages and benefits.
caption:
2,500 workers suddenly jobless. Five factories in Gazipur have shut their doors.

Five factories in Gazipur have shut down, leaving approximately 2,500 workers without a source of income.

The sudden closures have left thousands of families struggling to make ends meet as they face immediate unemployment.

The affected workers are now seeking solutions and support to address their loss of livelihoods.

Local authorities and industry representatives are being urged to ensure that workers receive their due wages and benefits.
